# Paul Irving

- **Age:** 19  <sub>[v4 c3 P7](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P49](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0049), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v4 c3 P7](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul has a delicately refined, beautiful face with dark blue eyes and a halo of chestnut curls, which he later crops close. He is small for his age as a child, but eventually grows into a tall six-foot man, resembling his father.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 c19 P25](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0025), [v2 c27 P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024), [v2 c28 P9](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0009), [v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002), [v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)_

## Personality

Paul is a sober, meditative, and imaginative child with an intense inner life and a love for fantasy, poetry, and nature. Though full of dreams, he is manly, fair-minded, and able to hold his own in games and tussles. He possesses uncanny insight, speaks in a thoughtful, mature manner, and remains devoted to those he loves.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c19 P33](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0033), [v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), [v2 c27 P54](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0054), [v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v4 c3 P6](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0006), [v4 c3 P33](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0033)_

## History

Paul Irving moves from the United States to Avonlea at age ten to reside with his grandmother, Mrs. Irving, on the shore road. He quickly forms a deep bond with his schoolteacher, Anne Shirley, who recognizes his imaginative genius and soul kinship. During his school years, he creates imaginary companions known as 'rock people' and writes whimsical letters and compositions. He visits Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge, where his resemblance to his father helps rekindle a romance that leads to his father Stephen Irving marrying Miss Lavendar. Following the wedding, Paul moves to Boston with his father, stepmother, and Charlotta the Fourth, returning to Echo Lodge for summer visits. As he grows older, he outgrows his imaginary companions, takes up football, and begins publishing poetry. At nineteen, he attends Anne's wedding at Green Gables before traveling abroad for two years of study.

## Quotes

> Please, teacher, I found these in Mr. Wright’s field, and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . . I like you, teacher.  <sub>[v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>

> I think the most interesting people I know are my rock people and I mean to tell you about them.  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)</sub>

> I love him the best in all the world, and Grandma Irving next, and then you, teacher.  <sub>[v2 c15 P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009)</sub>

> Mrs. Lynde, father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time.  <sub>[v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)</sub>

> You’ll never grow old, Teacher. You are one of the fortunate mortals who have found and drunk from the Fountain of Youth,—you and Mother Lavendar.  <sub>[v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>
